body:
The public PR741/PR799 verification commands now require the complete PR741 replay receipt before accepting reused ancestry or publishing success. This follows Lucas (@ljste)'s finding in #838 at `2a50020bb9564229874cbfbdc112e17b235bacfc`: the historical checker accepts a replaced stage or missing artifact when its receipt is changed consistently. **Tooling integration; no new κ and no independent-discovery claim.**

A new entrypoint requires all 22 ordered stages, all 44 artifact paths and agreement with `STAGES.json`, then retains every historical composition check. Both Make targets and both cold-replay workflows use it. The old verifiers are hash-pinned proof supplements, so their bytes, selected records and source packages remain untouched. Historical output is kept under `work/replay/`; only `work/RESULT.json` records successful completion of the new entrypoint.

Validation on isolated Linux CPython 3.12.15:

- All 11 new regression tests pass, including physical deletion of each of the 44 artifacts, coherently rehashed phase-stage replacement, stage-index disagreement, and actual CLI rejection before reuse starts.
- Existing PR741/PR799 binding suites and selected-record integrity pass with original proof hashes.
- Publication tests cover fresh/reused #799, #741, rejected postflight evidence and supplier failure. They substitute the expensive subprocess boundary and validate real archived evidence; they are not fresh construction runs.

```sh
python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_frontier_replay_coverage.py' -v
make frontier799-verify
```

Fresh full cold replay and hosted CI are **not claimed as locally completed**. Both updated CI workflows retain the full cold replay. The coverage gate detects omissions; it does not authenticate fabricated logs, audit every #799 obligation, or prove the multiplication theorem. The inherited mathematical assumptions and selected bound are unchanged.

Base: `f567884aeb8851b6e794af1184119a3bfbe1e631`. [Implementation, output layout and scope](https://github.com/chinmayarvind23/integer-mult-bounds/blob/72b8406b96ea2e0f37bb5143f594e12d4817c92a/docs/research/frontier-replay-coverage.md). Credit Lucas for #838; Douglas Colkitt for the checkers/replays; Chafik Boukhalfa for #741; DreamingOfClouds and eumemic for the #589/#555 lineage. Integration by Chinmay (@chinmayarvind23), with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, under Apache-2.0.
title: Tooling: require complete receipts in public frontier verification
